info.name: BAP Beckn Starter Kit
info.description:
Usecase-agnostic BAP requests for all Beckn Protocol v2.0.0 actions. All schema objects carry JSON-LD @context and @type annotations.

Set bap_adapter_url = http://localhost:8081/bap/caller before running.

request.description:
BAP selects resources from catalog.

Spec rules (beckn.yaml):
• Commitment.required = [status, resources, offer]
• status.descriptor.code ∈ {DRAFT, ACTIVE, CLOSED}
• resources = array of Resource (each needs @type, id, descriptor, quantity)
• offer.required = [@type, id, resourceIds]
• @context omitted on all core beckn.yaml objects

BAP provides buyer details, performance preferences, and payment intent.

Spec rules (beckn.yaml):
• participants carry buyer contact via participantAttributes (Attributes bag)
• performance.required = [@context, @type] per spec — @context kept as spec const
• settlements carry payment method via settlementAttributes (Attributes bag)
• @context omitted on all core beckn.yaml objects except Performance (spec-required)
BAP confirms the contract after payment or binding commitment.

variable.description: Base URL for bapUri / bppUri callbacks. Set to the ngrok tunnel (not host.docker.internal / beckn-router) because discover now targets a separate remote discovr stack that cannot reach a Docker-internal hostname for the async on_discover callback.
